title: pedicularis canadensis var. fluviatilis
intro: Pedicularis canadensis var. fluviatilis, commonly known as River Lousewort, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Orobanchaceae. River Lousewort is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that may help in reducing stress, improving sleep, and supporting immune function. The plant's therapeutic actions include acting as an adaptogen, sedative, and nervine, which may help in reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of River Lousewort include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
